name: railgaddi-monorepo
description: RailGaddi — Premium Live Train Journey Platform

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/utils
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.start: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run start:api" "npm run preview -w apps/web"

author: RailGaddi Team
